purpose.zh: 练前臂，让握力和手腕更有力
purpose.en: Build your forearms for a stronger grip and wrists.

text.zh: 前臂平放在大腿上，只动手腕
text.en: Rest your forearm on your thigh and move only your wrist

text.zh: 手腕往上卷，再慢慢往下放到底。
text.en: Curl your wrist up, then lower it slowly all the way down.

text.zh: 往上约 1 秒，往下约 2 秒。
text.en: Take about one second up and two seconds down.

commonErrors.en: Lifting the forearm instead of bending the wrist.

cautions.zh: 手腕不舒服时用更轻的哑铃、幅度小一点
cautions.en: If your wrist feels uncomfortable, use a lighter dumbbell and a smaller range.

changes: 名字「腕屈 + 腕伸」改为口语「坐姿哑铃上下卷腕 / Seated Full-Range Dumbbell Wrist Curl」
按 spec 关键帧手算相位：上卷 1.0、停 0.4、下放到底并回中 2.2、停 0.4（批表 flex 轨没包含往下那段）
cue3「上 1 秒下 3 秒」改成动画的「上约 1 秒、下约 2 秒」；删「过中立位」
